name: Zappa Dello
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Zappa Dello in Kaunertal**

Discover the **Zappa Dello**, a cozy mountain hut nestled in the heart of the **Kaunertal** valley. Here, you’ll find warmth, hearty Alpine cuisine, and breathtaking views of the **Ötztal Alps**.

Indulge in traditional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Speckknödel**, or **Tiroler Gröstl**, paired with the finest local beers and wines. Whether you’re hiking, skiing, or simply relaxing, the **Zappa Dello** is your perfect retreat in the **Kaunertal**.

**Come and experience the true spirit of Tirol!**
